name: Training Loss Functions for Implicit 3D Representation
aliases: RGB, Depth, Freespace, and Occupancy Losses
definition: A training procedure using three sets of pixels (P0, P1, P2) to define different loss components based on whether the pixel is inside/outside the object mask and whether a finite surface depth is predicted.
summary: This multi-task loss trains implicit 3D networks by partitioning pixels into disjoint sets to apply targeted photometric, depth, occupancy, and freespace losses, decoupling surface presence from appearance.
